notes: Variant assumption: standing landmine or barbell T-bar row with no chest pad, a close neutral handle, and a hip-hinged torso. No direct EMG study of a landmine T-bar row was found. The visible muscle map therefore uses row-family EMG from seated cable rows and prone rows, trunk EMG from free-weight rows, rotator cuff row evidence, and the peer-reviewed landmine row technique source. Erector spinae is visible support because the unsupported hinge is part of the chosen variant. Local anatomy mesh mappings resolve for all visible muscles.
